from z3 import *
import itertools

# Parameters
G = 18  # golfers
W = 7   # weeks
S = 6   # groups per week
K = 3   # group size

# Variables: x[w][g][p] = 1 if golfer p is in group g in week w
x = [[[Bool(f'x_{w}_{g}_{p}') for p in range(G)] for g in range(S)] for w in range(W)]

solver = Solver()

# Each golfer in exactly one group per week
for w in range(W):
    for p in range(G):
        solver.add(Sum([x[w][g][p] for g in range(S)]) == 1)

# Each group has exactly K golfers
for w in range(W):
    for g in range(S):
        solver.add(Sum([x[w][g][p] for p in range(G)]) == K)

# No pair of golfers in same group more than once
for p1 in range(G):
    for p2 in range(p1+1, G):
        # Sum over weeks and groups of (x[w][g][p1] and x[w][g][p2]) <= 1
        pair_weeks = []
        for w in range(W):
            for g in range(S):
                pair_weeks.append(And(x[w][g][p1], x[w][g][p2]))
        solver.add(Sum([If(pw, 1, 0) for pw in pair_weeks]) <= 1)

print("Solving...")
result = solver.check()
print(result)

import re

# Parse the model
G = 18
W = 7
S = 6
K = 3

solution = [0] * (W * G)

for line in model_str.strip().split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    m = re.match(r'\(define-fun g_(\d+)_(\d+) \(\) Int\s+(\d+)\)', line)
    if m:
        w = int(m.group(1))
        p = int(m.group(2))
        g = int(m.group(3))
        solution[w * G + p] = g

print("Solution:", solution)
print("Length:", len(solution))

# Verify
# Check each week: each group has exactly 3
for w in range(W):
    groups = [[] for _ in range(S)]
    for p in range(G):
        g = solution[w * G + p]
        groups[g].append(p)
    for g in range(S):
        assert len(groups[g]) == 3, f"Week {w}, group {g} has {len(groups[g])} members: {groups[g]}"
    print(f"Week {w}: {groups}")

# Check no pair appears twice
from collections import defaultdict
pair_weeks = defaultdict(list)
for w in range(W):
    groups = [[] for _ in range(S)]
    for p in range(G):
        g = solution[w * G + p]
        groups[g].append(p)
    for g in range(S):
        for i in range(K):
            for j in range(i+1, K):
                p1, p2 = groups[g][i], groups[g][j]
                pair = (min(p1, p2), max(p1, p2))
                pair_weeks[pair].append(w)

violations = 0
for pair, weeks in pair_weeks.items():
    if len(weeks) > 1:
        print(f"Pair {pair} appears in weeks {weeks}")
        violations += 1

if violations == 0:
    print("All pairs appear at most once! Verification passed!")
else:
    print(f"Found {violations} violations")
